name: Tappuah
overview: Tappuah is identified in Scripture as both a city and a personal name, highlighting its significance in the tribal landscape of Israel. It is named as a city within the territory of Judah (Joshua 15:34) and also appears as a border city associated with the tribe of Ephraim, located near the river Kanah (Joshua 16:8; 17:8). Additionally, Tappuah is listed as a son of Hebron, indicating a familial lineage connected to the region (1 Chronicles 2:43). The mention of a king of Tappuah (Joshua 12:17) further underscores its historical and political presence during the conquest period.
